author: fester
body: A small C# abstract syntax tree. Instead of concatenating raw C# strings, the plug builds a tree of named constructs -- usings, a namespace, classes, fields, methods, and parameters -- and a walker renders it. Method bodies and the IR-transpiled members remain raw C# text (the IR expression emitter produces those, and modelling every statement/expression is a separate, larger effort). This gives the file scaffolding and the runtime/WPF builtins a proper representation rather than a wall of string literals.

author: fester
body: The full C# expression / statement tree. The emitter walks IR into these nodes and render-cs-expr / render-cs-stmt produce text. CsRaw is the escape hatch for the few platform-specific fragments (BitConverter, Task.Run) not worth their own node.

author: fester
